courses.title: Individual Studies
courses.description: Creative projects, including nonthesis research, that are supervised on an individual basis and which fall outside the scope of formal courses. I H S 596 Individual Studies (1-9) This course is designed to allow students to study independent topics with industrial health and safety faculty. Grades will be assigned by the instructor according to a format agreed upon at the beginning of the period of study.
